book.title: Frankenstein · Chapter 4 — The Workshop of Filthy Creation
book.author: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1831), Chapter 4

cast.name: Victor
cast.canonical: a lean, slightly hunched young man with untidy dark hair, round glasses, dark shadowed feverish eyes, wearing a stained lab apron
cast.anchor: round glasses, a stained lab apron and dark shadowed eyes

cast.name: Krempe
cast.canonical: a short squat gruff professor in a curly powdered wig, permanent scowl, a jabbing pointed finger
cast.anchor: a curly powdered wig, squat build and a jabbing finger

cast.name: Waldman
cast.canonical: a benevolent bald old professor with half-moon spectacles and a scholar's gown, warm open-handed gesture, clean-shaven
cast.anchor: a bald head with half-moon spectacles and a scholar's gown

cast.name: Alphonse
cast.canonical: a tall stooped elderly gentleman, balding grey hair, a long white beard, leaning on a walking cane, in a long coat
cast.anchor: a long white beard and a walking cane (elderly, stooped)

panels.scene: a lean bespectacled young man in a stained lab apron bent alone over glowing chemical apparatus in a high garret laboratory before dawn, the last stars fading in the window, candle guttering, his shadowed eyes fixed and feverish
panels.composition: wide, solitary obsession, cool dawn light

teen.narration: AFTER WALDMAN'S LECTURE, CHEMISTRY BECOMES VICTOR'S WHOLE WORLD.

bubbles.text: From this day natural philosophy, and particularly chemistry... became nearly my sole occupation.
the stars often disappeared in the light of morning whilst I was yet engaged in my laboratory

panels.scene: a dwarfish short round pot-bellied old professor with a grey powdered wig and a deep scowling gruff face, barely chest-high, jabbing a stubby finger up at a tall lean bespectacled young man in a stained lab apron, a comic height difference, a cluttered lecture bench behind
panels.composition: two-shot caricature, tiny squat scowling professor beside tall student

teen.narration: KREMPE STILL NEEDLES HIM ABOUT THE OLD ALCHEMISTS.

bubbles.speaker: KREMPE
bubbles.text: how Cornelius Agrippa went on
In M. Waldman I found a true friend. His gentleness was never tinged by dogmatism

panels.scene: the same bespectacled young man alone at his cluttered desk deep at night, letters from home lying unopened and dusty, a small unlit portrait of a golden-haired woman turned aside, two years of seasons hinted in the window
panels.composition: wide, the pull of science over home

teen.narration: TWO YEARS PASS. HE NEVER ONCE GOES HOME TO GENEVA.

bubbles.text: Two years passed in this manner, during which I paid no visit to Geneva
None but those who have experienced them can conceive of the enticements of science.

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man holding a candle up to a human skeleton and anatomical drawings pinned to the wall, gazing with dawning obsession, deep shadows

teen.narration: ONE QUESTION BEGINS TO CONSUME HIM.

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Whence, I often asked myself, did the principle of life proceed?
It was a bold question, and one which has ever been considered as a mystery

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man in a dark coat stepping through the iron gate of a moonlit churchyard at night, a lantern low in his hand, leaning gravestones around him, resolute and grim

bubbles.text: To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death.
a churchyard was to me merely the receptacle of bodies deprived of life

panels.scene: a dim vaulted charnel-house lit by a single lantern, the bespectacled young man crouched examining decay and bone, unflinching, cobwebs and stone niches around him
panels.composition: wide, days and nights among the dead

teen.narration: FOR DAYS AND NIGHTS HE HAUNTS THE VAULTS.

bubbles.text: forced to spend days and nights in vaults and charnel-houses
I saw how the worm inherited the wonders of the eye and brain

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man struck motionless as a brilliant beam of light breaks over him out of surrounding darkness, awe and terror on his lit face, arms half-raised

teen.narration: THEN, OUT OF THE DARKNESS — A SUDDEN LIGHT.

bubbles.text: from the midst of this darkness a sudden light broke in upon me-a light so brilliant and wondrous, yet so simple

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Remember, I am not recording the vision of a madman.

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man alone, face transfigured with rapture and dread, a faint spark of animation glowing between his cupped hands

teen.narration: HE HAS FOUND THE SECRET OF LIFE ITSELF.

bubbles.text: I succeeded in discovering the cause of generation and life; nay, more, I became myself capable of bestowing animation upon lifeless matter.
The astonishment which I had at first experienced on this discovery soon gave place to delight and rapture.

panels.scene: a gaunt older frame-narrator version of the same bespectacled man, hollow-cheeked and grave, looking directly out as if warning the listener, firelight on his ravaged face
panels.composition: close, direct address, a warning from the future

teen.narration: FROM THE RUIN OF HIS FUTURE, VICTOR WARNS US.

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Learn from me, if not by my precepts, at least by my example, how dangerous is the acquirement of knowledge
how much happier that man is who believes his native town to be the world, than he who aspires to become greater than his nature will allow

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man in a stained lab apron leaning over a large drafting table, drawing on a huge sheet the full head-to-toe outline of a giant eight-foot human figure, calipers in his hand, the oversized anatomical diagram dominating the page, cold ambition in his shadowed eyes

teen.narration: HE RESOLVES TO BUILD A BEING — BUT GIGANTIC.

bubbles.text: to make the being of a gigantic stature, that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: It was with these feelings that I began the creation of a human being.

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man haloed in visionary light, arms outspread, imagining a radiant torrent of light pouring into a dark world, exalted and blind to danger

teen.narration: HE DREAMS OF BECOMING A CREATOR OF A NEW RACE.

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Life and death appeared to me ideal bounds, which I should first break through, and pour a torrent of light into our dark world.
A new species would bless me as its creator and source

panels.scene: a cramped attic cell at the very top of the house crowded with specimen jars, retorts and bone, a long sheet-shrouded gigantic human form lying on a central workbench slab, the bespectacled young man in a stained apron standing beside it with staring bloodshot eyes, a single oil lamp burning

teen.narration: IN A GARRET CELL HE HIDES HIS WORKSHOP OF FILTHY CREATION.

bubbles.text: In a solitary chamber, or rather cell, at the top of the house
I kept my workshop of filthy creation... my eyeballs were starting from their sockets in attending to the details of my employment

panels.scene: moonlight through a high window falling on the emaciated bespectacled young man bent over his grim work, pale and hollow, the moon a cold witness
panels.composition: close, midnight labour under the moon

teen.narration: NIGHT AFTER NIGHT, WASTING, HE WORKS ON.

bubbles.text: the moon gazed on my midnight labours, while, with unrelaxed and breathless eagerness, I pursued nature to her hiding-places
My cheek had grown pale with study, and my person had become emaciated with confinement.

panels.scene: the emaciated bespectacled young man carrying a sack of bones up a dark staircase from a charnel vault, face turned with loathing yet driven on, grim resolve

teen.narration: HE ROBS THE GRAVES FOR HIS MATERIALS.

bubbles.text: I collected bones from charnel-houses and disturbed, with profane fingers, the tremendous secrets of the human frame.
The dissecting room and the slaughter-house furnished many of my materials

panels.scene: a radiant summer landscape of harvest fields and vines beyond a window, while inside the pale bespectacled young man ignores it entirely, an unanswered letter from his father in his slack hand

teen.narration: A BEAUTIFUL SUMMER PASSES UNSEEN. HIS FATHER WRITES.

bubbles.text: The summer months passed while I was thus engaged, heart and soul, in one pursuit.

bubbles.speaker: ALPHONSE
bubbles.text: You must pardon me if I regard any interruption in your correspondence as a proof that your other duties are equally neglected.

panels.scene: the withered autumn leaves falling past the window as the ravaged, trembling bespectacled young man startles at a single drifting leaf, near collapse, the shrouded giant nearly finished behind him
panels.composition: wide, a wreck on the brink of completion

teen.narration: BY AUTUMN HE IS A WRECK — AND THE WORK IS ALMOST DONE.

bubbles.text: The leaves of that year had withered before my work drew near to a close
the fall of a leaf startled me, and I shunned my fellow creatures as if I had been guilty of a crime
the energy of my purpose alone sustained me
